Coram : ARUN MISHRA, AMITAVA ROY
Specific Relief Act, 1963: s.12 - Non-applicability of - Agreement for sale of property between appellant-defendant and re!>pondent-plaintiffs - Plaintiffs paid earnest money - Another payment made by plaintiffs on 31.1.1990 - Subsequently, plaintiffs filed suit for agreement for sale and in the alternative claimed D refund of earnest money with interest and damages - Trial court dismissed the suit holding that the plaintiffs were not ready and willing to perform their part of the agreement and also that the plaintiffs did not have arrangement of balance
Decision Date : 18-04-2017 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 5636/2017 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
